work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCXXVII extends to anti-blasphemy sodalities founded during missions the indulgences of the Roman Caravita sodality; intitulation, narrative, grant, transumpt clause and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF40554. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF40466–40466; the source dating clause at LF40515–40518 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die octava augusti millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
